change_summary: cue-free blind calibration: candidate keeps readable NL-derived display labels while adding opaque effect_token_* variables and shorter internal event ids; no state/transition topology is deleted, but the new effect tokens lack a trace map, so static evidence is insufficient for a strict gain or regression verdict.
